purpose: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next for agentic coding: four native 262,144-token slots (1,048,576 total), NVFP4 experts, PLE table read in place from NVMe, MTP k=3, fp8 KV, prefix cache, decode CUDA graphs. Not the default until the owner decides.

status.basis: Community single-Spark vLLM reports (tonyd2wild, madeye; Sep 2026): ~76 GiB resident weights with the PLE table on NVMe, 36.8-45.8 tok/s single-stream decode with MTP3, ~1,600-1,824 tok/s prefill, KV pool ~0.5-1.0M fp8 tokens. Not yet measured on this host.

safety.note: 10 GiB whole-host floor per the AGENTS.md 1M gate. cgroup MemoryCurrent is blind to CUDA unified memory on GB10; the external memwatch is the real guard. The PLE table's page cache is clean and file-backed (reclaimable).

memory_model.basis: Sized from the 2026-10-11 diagnostic smoke (results/qwen38fn-gates/smoke-2026-10-11): vLLM reported 75.67 GiB model load and the non-KV footprint was ~83.6 GiB at idle. Its 4,200,000,000-byte fp8 KV arena held 194,493 tokens at --max-model-len 131,072 (attention block 3,200). A request costs cdiv(L, 3200) blocks per attention group plus a fixed count per GDN-state and QSA-ring group, so twice that per-request cost bounds a 262,144-token slot and four slots need >= 22,643,587,173 bytes. The fixed 22.7 GB arena (--kv-cache-memory-bytes, 21.14 GiB) is extra_gib. Overhead covers CUDA context, 4,096-token prefill activations, MTP and CUDA graphs. Projected idle low point on a quiet host ~15 GiB before prefill activations, so the direct 1M fill needs a quiet host.

qualification_targets.note: qwen38-1m README row (results/qwen38-gates/speed-2026-08-18, accuracy-2026-08-18); Flash-Next must match or beat these to replace or complement the default. Speed targets are general, misses are reported.
